name: chrome-fx
description: chrome-fx@1 (#1436; canvas primitives: Effect): the first-party pack of effects on the app's own surfaces. Each operator is a pass graph from the public steps that reads its element's backdrop and draws it opaque, ending in the same contrast keeper, which holds the ink tiers over it at their floors. Each has its params in order (pt params are multiplied by the window's scale), a class (quiet may run in working views; expressive only where a look or a panel you picked asks for it), an authored still pose it holds under reduced motion, its measured cost, its fixture and its planted twin.
